fee_notes: Single Studio fee is $50,000, reduced by $5,000 for VetFran (IFA) participants or franchises at least 51% woman or minority owned, making the effective low $45,000. For Development Agreements (multiple studios), fees are structured per unit: $45,000/unit for 2 units, $40,000/unit for 3–5 units, $35,000/unit for 6+ units, with an additional $5,000 reduction for VetFran. No additional Initial Franchise Fee is charged at signing of each subsequent Franchise Agreement under a Development Agreement. A separate $8,000 initial training fee applies to the first studio (not included in the franchise fee figures above). The Initial Franchise Fee is non-refundable and deemed fully earned upon execution of the Franchise Agreement.
raw_excerpt: When you purchase the right to develop a single Studio, at the time you sign the Franchise Agreement, you will pay us an Initial Franchise Fee of $ 50,000 in a lump sum . If you qualify for the VetFran program sponsored by the International Franchise Association ("IFA") or if your franchise entity is at least 51% woman or minority owned, the Initial Franchise Fee you pay for a single Studio will be reduced by $5,000. ... Initial Franchise Fees: $45,000 per unit – two (2) franchised units; $40,000 per unit – three (3) to five (5) franchised units; $35,000 per unit – six (6) or more franchised units.
